name: Voxels Grid to Compressed Mesh Conversion
definition: Converts a voxel grid into a compressed mesh representation using a Marching Cubes-like approach, sharing vertices and faces across adjacent voxels to reduce redundancy.
summary: Voxels Grid to Compressed Mesh Conversion transforms a voxel grid into a compact triangular mesh by sharing vertices and faces to reduce redundancy, producing a blocky, axis-aligned representation distinct from standard mesh conversion.
